title: pulsatilla halleri subsp. rhodopaea
intro: Pulsatilla halleri subsp. rhodopaea, commonly known as the Balkan pasque flower, is a flowering plant species within the ranunculaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and aiding in the relief of menstrual cramps and other symptoms associated with PMS. The therapeutic actions of Pulsatilla halleri subsp. rhodopaea include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and an emmenagogue, helping to regulate menstrual cycles and ease symptoms of menopause. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
